Added telemetry-driven pixel RPM, timing, fuel-level, ABS and TCS indicators, with isolated redraws for stable updates.

Improved shared dashboard icon rendering and refined fuel-pump placement across Pocket, GT3 and Mono themes.
1.7.2: Added an idle-screen Touch Setup flow that detects and saves 0, 90, 180 or 270 degree touch orientation corrections.
Added double-tap entry, verification and dual-orientation Cancel handling so accidental or incorrect calibration remains recoverable.
Touch Setup now exits immediately when GT7 telemetry resumes and never blocks heartbeat, UDP or dashboard rendering.
1.7.1: Added a row-based fuel-level treatment to the Pocket fuel-pump icon, with a clear light-above and dark-below liquid boundary.
Updated Theme Preview mock telemetry to demonstrate the Pocket fuel indicator at 80 percent.
Refined the Pocket ABS indicator proportions and alignment.
1.7.0: Added the Pocket dashboard theme with a Game Boy-inspired pixel interface and adaptive GT7 telemetry presentation.
Added pixel-style RPM, lap, position, timing, fuel, ABS and TCS indicators optimized for 320 x 240 displays.
Improved Pocket driving-aid redraw isolation to prevent fuel, ABS and TCS indicators from flickering together.
Refined Pocket iconography, layout spacing, typography and shift-light visibility through physical display testing.

Added a segmented monochrome shift-light, dynamic GT7 alert marker and shift-warning pulse.
Refined Mono timing, position, lap, delta, fuel, remaining-lap, tyre, pedal and driving-aid presentation for 320 x 240 displays.

Kept heartbeat, UDP telemetry, discovery, Wi-Fi and sleep handling independent from theme preview rendering.
